description: This file defines the ThreadPool class and related nested classes and interfaces for managing a thread pool, including job scheduling, execution, and monitoring within the Thunder::Core namespace. It includes definitions for jobs, schedulers, dispatchers, and minions, as well as mechanisms for job resubmission, scheduling, and thread management.

classes.name: ThreadPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of worker threads, job scheduling, and execution, including monitoring and callback mechanisms.

classes.name: ThreadPool::ICallback
classes.description: Interface for callback to notify when the thread pool is idle.

classes.name: ThreadPool::IJob
classes.description: Interface representing a job that can be resubmitted within the thread pool.

classes.name: ThreadPool::IScheduler
classes.description: Interface for scheduling jobs at specific times.

classes.name: ThreadPool::IDispatcher
classes.description: Interface for initializing, deinitializing, and dispatching jobs.

classes.name: ThreadPool::Metadata
classes.description: Structure containing metadata about worker threads.

classes.name: ThreadPool::DispatchedJobMetaData
classes.description: Metadata for dispatched jobs, used in warning reporting and monitoring.

classes.name: ThreadPool::JobType
classes.description: Template class representing a job with various states and resubmission logic.

classes.name: ThreadPool::Minion
classes.description: Represents a worker entity that processes jobs, manages job lifecycle, and interacts with the dispatcher.

classes.name: ThreadPool::Executor
classes.description: Represents a thread executing a Minion, managing thread lifecycle and processing.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes the current job request, dispatching it via the dispatcher and handling monitoring.

methods.name: Resubmit
methods.description: Resubmits a job for execution, possibly with a new scheduled time.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches the current job request via the dispatcher.

methods.name: Idle
methods.description: Callback invoked when the thread pool becomes idle.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Provides metadata about a worker thread.

methods.name: Completed
methods.description: Marks a job as completed and updates internal state.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Attempts to revoke a scheduled or running job.

methods.name: RevokeRequired
methods.description: Checks if a job needs to be revoked.

methods.name: Identifier
methods.description: Returns a string identifier for the job.
